title: Corderon - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Corderon in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Corderon is a dark-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Defense (C), Luck (D).

sections.title: Is the Corderon Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (C), Luck (D). A dedicated dark pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
